description: Find upcoming and live events (games) from a plain question such as 'Broncos v Bulldogs', 'AFL grand final' or 'Australia v New Zealand'. Returns matching events with start times (local and UTC) and event IDs (ev_...), but no prices. Pass league_id whenever you know the league (for example afl, nrl, nfl, mlb, rlwc): it keeps the search small, because every event returned counts as one object against the key's monthly allowance. With no team named, it lists the soonest events in the league.

days_ahead.description: Only events starting within this many days. Default 14.

league_id.description: League key, for example afl, nrl, nfl, mlb or rlwc. Strongly recommended.

limit.description: Most events to fetch. Default 25 with a league, 50 without.

query.description: Plain question or team names, for example 'Broncos v Bulldogs' or 'AFL grand final'

name: find_event
title: Find an event
